title: PH, US eye $2-billion defense loan, expanded trade ties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and the United States will pursue a military financing package worth more than $2 billion to strengthen the country’s defense capabilities. The proposed loan package was among the defense and economic commitments outlined by the White House in a fact sheet released Wednesday following US President Donald Trump’s visit to Manila.
